name: prototipo-backend
description: Protótipo tripartido: a mesma API de tarefas em Monólito, Camadas (MVC) e Clean Architecture, mais o serviço de benchmark.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api-monolito -w api-camadas -w api-clean -w bench
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && tsc -p api-monolito --noEmit && tsc -p api-camadas --noEmit && tsc -p api-clean --noEmit && tsc -p bench --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w api-monolito -w api-camadas -w api-clean -w bench
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w api-monolito -w api-camadas -w api-clean
